items.html: *Behold, in the previous chapters we explained the matter of Ima, that she divides into three parts in this manner: the first nine Sefirot of Ima are called Upper Bina; the Tevuna is the discernment of the Malchut of Bina, like Rachel who is the Malchut of ZA. And this Tevuna likewise divides in two, and from the Chazeh downward it becomes a third Partzuf, which is the Malchut of this aforementioned Tevuna. And this third Partzuf of the lower Tevuna is the one that clothes within ZA.
